title: GroupRead
description: Output of `group read`. With a `<groupPathInModel>` argument: one group read back — its `repeatable` flag (plus `maxRepetitions` when repeatable, `indexField` when set), `fields` (its DIRECT child field paths), and its projected common metadata. Metadata is written through `meta <ref>` (G45) but retained here so one group summary remains complete. With NO argument: a lean name-index — `groups` (every group's full path) + `count`.

repeatable.description: (one group) whether the group repeats (rules over it iterate per row)

maxRepetitions.description: (one group) the maximum number of rows; present only for a repeatable group

indexField.description: (one group) the repetition row-key field, if one is set

sortFields.description: (one group) the declared row sort keys (display/USB ordering), in order, present only when any are set

label.description: (one group) locale → display label, when set

annotations.description: (one group) annotation name → value, when set

internalDescription.description: (one group) locale → internal description, when set

externalDescription.description: (one group) locale → external description, when set

fields.description: (one group) the group's DIRECT child field paths (a deeper field belongs to a nested sub-group; see `model describe` for the full tree)

groups.description: (name-index) every group's full name-path, in document order — pass one back as `group read <path>`
